usage: agentware graph teardown [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--repo REPO]
                                [--kb-repo KB_REPO]
                                [--integration-branch INTEGRATION_BRANCH]
                                [--force] [--dry-run]
                                name

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --repo REPO           package repo override
  --kb-repo KB_REPO     KB repo override
  --integration-branch INTEGRATION_BRANCH
                        integration branch for the merged check
  --force               remove even unmerged/dirty lanes (R-GIT-02 override)
  --dry-run             print what would be removed; remove nothing
